SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(ROLE_ID), 0) AS totcnt FROM TB_ROLEINFO WHERE 1=1
AND ROLE_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT A.MENU_NO , A.MENU_ORDR , A.MENU_NM , A.UPPER_MENU_NO , A.MENU_BASIC_INFO , ( SELECT COUNT(B.MENU_NO) FROM COMTNMENUCREATDTLS B WHERE B.MENU_NO = A.MENU_NO AND B.ROLE_ID = #{roleId}) AS "chkYeoBu" FROM COMTNMENUINFO A WHERE A.MENU_NO > 0 ORDER BY A.MENU_ORDR

SELECT A.MENU_NO , A.MENU_ORDR , A.MENU_NM , A.UPPER_MENU_NO , SUBSTRING(B.MENU_BASIC_INFO FROM 1 FOR 1) AS MENU_S , SUBSTRING(B.MENU_BASIC_INFO FROM 2 FOR 1) AS MENU_I , SUBSTRING(B.MENU_BASIC_INFO FROM 3 FOR 1) AS MENU_E , SUBSTRING(B.MENU_BASIC_INFO FROM 4 FOR 1) AS MENU_D , SUBSTRING(B.MENU_BASIC_INFO FROM 5 FOR 1) AS MENU_X FROM COMTNMENUINFO A, COMTNMENUCREATDTLS B WHERE A.MENU_NO = B.MENU_NO
AND A.MENU_NO > 0
AND UPPER_MENU_NO <> 0
AND B.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY A.MENU_NO

SELECT A.MENU_NO , A.MENU_ORDR , A.MENU_NM , A.UPPER_MENU_NO , SUBSTRING(B.MENU_BASIC_INFO FROM 1 FOR 1) AS MENU_S , SUBSTRING(B.MENU_BASIC_INFO FROM 2 FOR 1) AS MENU_I , SUBSTRING(B.MENU_BASIC_INFO FROM 3 FOR 1) AS MENU_E , SUBSTRING(B.MENU_BASIC_INFO FROM 4 FOR 1) AS MENU_D , SUBSTRING(B.MENU_BASIC_INFO FROM 5 FOR 1) AS MENU_X FROM COMTNMENUINFO A, COMTNMENUCREATDTLS B WHERE A.MENU_NO = B.MENU_NO
AND A.MENU_NO > 0
AND UPPER_MENU_NO <> 0
AND B.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY A.MENU_NO
SELECT b.MANAGER_ID FROM TB_ROLEINFO a, TB_MANAGERINFO b WHERE a.ROLE_ID = b.ROLE_ID AND a.ROLE_ID = #{params.roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNMENUCREATDTLS ( ROLE_ID ,MENU_NO , MENU_BASIC_INFO, MENU_CREATE_DATE, MENU_CREATE_ID) VALUES ( #{roleId}, #{menuNo} , #{menuBasicInfo}, NOW(), #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE COMTNMENUCREATDTLS SET MAPNG_CREAT_ID = #{mapCreatId} WHERE ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
